build_clevr_dataset: build the CLEVR dataset by downloading and extracting the zip archive to the MMF data folder
load_clevr_dataset: load a CLEVRDataset instance from the extracted data folder using config and dataset type
get_clevr_config_path: get the default YAML config path for the CLEVR dataset builder
update_registry_for_model: register the CLEVR text vocab size and number of final outputs in the MMF registry
review_clevr_builder: review the CLEVRBuilder class and its download, extraction, and dataset loading logic
